import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem finite_connected_union_predecessor {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (A : ℕ → Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    0 < n →
    (∀ k < n, IsConnected (A k)) →
    (∀ k, 0 < k → k < n →
      (A k ∩ ⋃ j ∈ Finset.range k, A j).Nonempty) →
    IsConnected (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro h
    omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro _ hA h_inter
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn
      have h_eq : (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (0 + 1), A k) = A 0 := by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_one_iff]
        simp
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hA 0 (by omega)
    · have hn_pos : 0 < n := by omega
      have ih_conn : IsConnected (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) := by
        apply ih hn_pos
        · intro k hk
          exact hA k (by omega)
        · intro k hk0 hkn
          exact h_inter k hk0 (by omega)
      have hAn : IsConnected (A n) := hA n (by omega)
      have hinter_n : ((⋃ j ∈ Finset.range n, A j) ∩ A n).Nonempty := by
        rw [Set.inter_comm]
        exact h_inter n hn_pos (by omega)
      have h_union : (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), A k) = (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) ∪ A n := by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, Set.mem_union]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨i, hi, hx⟩
          obtain rfl | hi' := eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hi)
          · exact Or.inr hx
          · exact Or.inl ⟨i, hi', hx⟩
        · rintro (⟨i, hi, hx⟩ | hx)
          · exact ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi, hx⟩
          · exact ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n, hx⟩
      rw [h_union]
      exact IsConnected.union hinter_n ih_conn hAn
